author: Michael Larabel
description: Mesa 26.3 is out today as the fourth quarter Mesa3D feature release for this collection of open-source OpenGL and Vulkan drivers...
title: Mesa 26.3 Released With VK_AMD_anti_lag For RADV, Many Other Vulkan Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Firefox 160.0 release builds are now available as the latest bi-weekly stable update to Mozilla's web browser...
title: Firefox 160 Available With Speech-To-Text, MKV Files With FLAC / MP3 / PCM Audio

author: Michael Larabel
description: Since the beginning of the year there have been AMDGPU LLVM back-end patches for GFX13 as AMD's next-generation graphics IP. This is most likely for RDNA 5 graphics. Now out today are the GFX13 patches finally surfacing for the AMDGPU Linux kernel graphics driver...
title: AMDGPU Linux Driver Patches Posted For Enabling GFX13 Graphics IP - RDNA5

author: Michael Larabel
description: Darling is the software project more than a decade in development that is designed to run macOS binaries on Linux. This macOS compatibility layer for Linux is now gaining more brisk developments as it turns to AI/LLMs to assist in this creation...
title: Darling Now Embraces AI For Running macOS Binaries On Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Linux kernel's ChaCha symmetric stream cipher code has long had an AVX-512 optimized code path but it was catering to the early generations of Intel CPUs with AVX-512 (Skylake) that suffered from down-clocking under use. But now slated for arrival with Linux 7.5 is tuning the code to perform better on today's AVX-512 Intel and AMD processors that don't suffer from this limitation. In turn the ChaCha performance is as much as 99% faster with current-generation AMD Zen 5 processors...
title: ChaCha AVX-512 Optimization For Linux 7.5 Yields Up To 99% Improvement On AMD Zen 5

author: Michael Larabel
description: MSI's latest Ryzen motherboards with AMD 800 series chipsets feature a new capability marked as Mystic Light for RGB lighting controls of the motherboard as well as compatible graphics cards and cases. MSI Mystic Light control software is only offered for Microsoft Windows but thanks to an open-source developer with the help of Claude Code, a Mystic Light open-source driver is being worked on for the Linux kernel...
title: Linux Seeing Driver Work For MSI Mystic Light On Latest Ryzen Motherboards

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged for Linux 6.13 back in 2024 was multigrain timestamp support for being able to switch between coarse and fine-grained change/modification time reporting on a per-file basis. This is useful if caring about accuracy more than the once-per-jiffy timestamps on files and was originally devised as a way of addressing NFS caching issues. A limitation of multigrain timestamps though has been the lack of  user-space to know whether a file's timestamps are multi-grain or not...
title: Linux 7.5 To Convey To User-Space Multi-Grain Timestamp Usage On Files

author: Michael Larabel
description: Samsung's Galaxy XR headset runs on Android XR by default with its own downstream kernel patches. A user leveraging AI with multiple LLMs has now drafted an initial set of patches getting the Galaxy XR headset working on the mainline kernel along with bringing up the Qualcomm Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 "Halliday" SoC that powers this VR/XR headset...
title: New Linux Patches Bring-Up The Samsung Galaxy XR Headset, Qualcomm Halliday SoC

author: Michael Larabel
description: Hyunjun Ko of Igalia continues working on enhancing the Vulkan Video support in the Mesa ANV driver for better open-source video acceleration support...
title: Intel ANV Lands Bitrate Control For AV1 Encoding
